source.author: lucan
source.text: Aeternis chalybum nodis, et carcere Ditis Constrictae plausere manus, camposque piorum Poscit turba nocens.
source.text_original: Aeternis chalybum nodis, et carcere Ditis / Constrictae plausere manus, camposque piorum / Poscit turba nocens.
source.text_english: With everlasting chains of steel and in the prison of Dis, their hands, bound, clapped; and the guilty crowd demands the fields of the righteous.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_original: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum / secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_english: Go, you are mine; already the dutiful band of the silent summons you to the groves, and Father Aeolus, flying about, calls you to the hidden fields.
